titulo: The future: Which future to choose

aula.objetivo: Form the future with «буду» + infinitive and with the perfective verb, and choose between the two.

blocos.titulo: буду versus perfective: process or result
blocos.explicacao: The choice follows the same logic as in the past. Do you want to talk about a process, a habit or a duration? Use «буду» + imperfective infinitive. Do you want to talk about a result, a single completed action? Use the perfective future.

tabela.exemplo: Завтра я буду работать весь день.

blocos.contexto: Two friends talk about the next day.

linhas.pt: — What are you going to do tomorrow?

linhas.ru: — Утром я буду работать. Вечером я позвоню маме.
linhas.pt: — In the morning I'm going to work. In the evening I'm going to call my mother.
linhas.audio: Утром я буду работать. Вечером я позвоню маме.

linhas.ru: — В субботу я буду отдыхать. Мы будем гулять в парке.
linhas.pt: — On Saturday I'm going to rest. We're going to walk in the park.
linhas.audio: В субботу я буду отдыхать. Мы будем гулять в парке.

linhas.pt: — Great! Are you going to buy bread?

linhas.ru: — Да, куплю. Я обязательно куплю хлеб и молоко.
linhas.pt: — Yes, I will. I will definitely buy bread and milk.
linhas.audio: Да, куплю. Я обязательно куплю хлеб и молоко.

blocos.ru: Завтра я буду дома. Утром я прочитаю книгу и напишу письмо. Днём я буду готовить обед. Вечером я позвоню другу, и мы будем смотреть фильм.
blocos.pt: Tomorrow I will be at home. In the morning I will read a book and write a letter. During the day I will prepare lunch. In the evening I will call a friend and we will watch a movie.

blocos.enunciado: Tell your plan for tomorrow, with «буду» and with the perfective.
Write 3 sentences with «буду» and 3 with the perfective future.
